branch_interpolation.boundary_reaudit: interpolated inner/outer incoming counts must remain 0/11
branch_interpolation.normal_hyperbolicity: interpolated fast spectral gap must remain strictly positive
branch_interpolation.source_matrix: convex interpolation with the common first-four-coordinate nullspace verified before use
branch_interpolation.state: convex state interpolation followed by z<-z+N(q-Cz)
branch_interpolation.trust: query distance and simplex diameter must remain inside every contributing trust radius
branch_interpolation.weights: six nonnegative barycentric coordinates summing to one

driver_interpolation.invariants: nonnegative barycentric weights on one precomputed 4-simplex
driver_interpolation.outside_hull: fail closed; nearest-neighbor or extrapolated fallback forbidden
driver_interpolation.phase: periodic piecewise-linear interpolation on S1 using two adjacent nodes
driver_interpolation.tensor_weights: ten nonnegative products summing to one

event_and_reset_interpolation.destination_mode: single-valued and fixed within each transition class
event_and_reset_interpolation.event_map: convex duration, ledger impulse and ledger-null constitutive jump
event_and_reset_interpolation.guard: class-pure convex interpolation of reduced guard normals and offsets
event_and_reset_interpolation.orientation: all contributing normals have positive dot product after frozen orientation
event_and_reset_interpolation.reset: certified weighted reset geometry re-enforces C(z_plus-z_minus)=Delta q_event exactly
event_and_reset_interpolation.transversality: grad(g) dot (qdot,phidot) has prospectively frozen nonzero margin

online_hybrid_state.reconstruction: z_star(q,phi,m) plus optional certified fast correction

branch_additions.branch_simplices6: precomputed mode-pure simplices in local (q4,unwrapped phi)

driver_additions.q_simplices5: precomputed 4-D invariant simplices, five vertices each

event_additions.event_simplices6: class-pure convex simplices on each guard sheet
event_additions.reduced_guard_normals5: normalized gradients with respect to (q4,unwrapped phi)
event_additions.reduced_guard_offsets: signed affine offsets at each event truth point

heldout_additions.withheld_full_sequence: never used for simplex construction or coefficient fitting
heldout_additions.withheld_guard_points: signed values on both sides plus transverse crossing times

schema_v2_extension.reason: schema v1 records event crossing direction but no reduced guard normal; it cannot define an online guard surface
